final:
config_value(text: str, key: str) -> str =
  ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
  ex config_value("a=1\nb=2", "c") == ""
  ex config_value("", "a") == ""
  for line in text.split("\n")
    let parts = line.split("=")
    let k = parts.get(0) else ""
    if parts.len() > 1 and k == key
      var v = ""
      for i in range(1, parts.len())
        if i > 1
          v += "="
        v += parts[i]
      return v
  ""

test_config_value() =
  assert config_value("a=1\nb=2", "b") == "2"
  assert config_value("a=1\nb=2", "c") == ""
  assert config_value("", "a") == ""
  assert config_value("u=x=y", "u") == "x=y"
